name: Pastime Athletic Club
intro: Book the gymnasium and club rooms.
rules: Bookings can be cancelled up to {cancel_cutoff} before the start time. Within {cancel_cutoff}, they can't be cancelled.
If you can't make your booking, please let management know.
Missed bookings are tracked by management. Members who miss {missed_bookings} may lose booking privileges for {suspension_length}.
Please book only the time you'll use, so other members get a turn.
Your member number and PIN are for you only. Don't share them.
